title: PPG-MS12 — Regression Harness + Fleet Rollout (CI gate + JM Die cutover playbook)
description: The closing milestone: a 50-program golden corpus that locks in cycle time, surface finish, and forces; a byte-diff regression harness that runs in CI on every post change; a physics-drift detector that flags silent canonical-constant changes; and the JM Die cutover playbook that turns 12 PPG-MS milestones into a Monday-morning shop-floor rollout.
rationale: Without a regression harness, the moment the closed loop (PPG-MS11) starts moving canonical constants there's no way to tell intentional learning from drift bug. Without a cutover playbook the operators don't know which machine to point at PRISM first or what to do when something diverges. This milestone is the difference between 'shipped' and 'in production'.
leverage_existing: All previous PPG-MS deliverables (sidecar, block-by-block S/F, iMachining, WEDM, fleet, dialects, wizard, mill print, omega tier, AGI gates, PDF tribal, online tuning)
vitest CI workflow already wired in .github/workflows/ci.yml
ProductionToolpathRegressionEngine + cycle_time_compare action — already in cam dispatcher

the_worked_example_that_proves_it.scenario: Engineer changes kc1.1 for ISO-P from 1800 to 1850 in src/physics/constants.ts (legitimate calibration outcome from PPG-MS11).
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.today_pre_ppg_ms12: Change merges. Some posts emit different feeds. No way to tell whether the new feeds are right. Programmer at JM Die gets surprised on Monday.
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.should_be_post_ppg_ms12: CI byte-diff regression flags the 12 affected golden programs; cycle-time delta within ±5%; chatter/force ceilings unviolated; ProductionToolpathRegressionEngine flags drift band; PR description auto-annotated with 'kc1.1 ISO-P recalibration: -3.2% mean cycle time, max +0.6% force'. Reviewer + JM Die sign off; cutover playbook §K updates the operator note.
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.gap_now_closed: Calibration is measurable, reviewable, and reversible.

units.title: Golden-program corpus (50 JM Die programs)
units.scope: Curate 50 programs from JM DIE/ — mix of mill, lathe, WEDM, sinker EDM, multi-channel; persist outputs (G-code + sidecar + setup sheet); seal canonical bytes

units.title: Byte-diff regression harness
units.scope: src/__tests__/regression/post-corpus.regression.test.ts — diff vs golden; allow tolerated changes (timestamp, sidecar SHA); flag everything else; runs in CI

units.title: Physics drift detector (sidecar SHA + canonical constant alerts)
units.scope: src/engines/PostPhysicsDriftDetectorEngine.ts — when src/physics/constants.ts changes, recompute every golden sidecar SHA; PR comment annotates affected programs + computes cycle-time/force delta

units.title: CI workflow (.github/workflows/ppg-regression.yml)
units.scope: Run regression harness + drift detector on every PR touching post engines, dialect emitters, physics constants, or sidecar schema

units.title: JM Die cutover playbook
units.scope: docs/jm-die-ppg-cutover-playbook.md — Monday-morning sequence: which machine first, what to verify, fallback to manual, escalation, sign-off; per-machine quickref

units.title: Ops handoff docs + on-call rotation
units.scope: docs/ppg-ops-runbook.md — what to do when canary flags drift, when sidecar SHA mismatches, when MTConnect/OPC-UA reader stalls, escalation tree

units.title: Pipeline stage fusion (perf budget enforcement in CI)
units.scope: Closes PPG-REAL-MS0/U-PPR47. Adds PostProcessorPipelineEngine perf budget per stage; CI gate fails if any stage > 2x baseline; visible in PR comment with stage delta table. PostPhysicsDriftDetectorEngine extension.

units.title: Result caching for tool+material+machine tuples
units.scope: Closes PPG-REAL-MS0/U-PPR48. Adds memoization layer keyed on (tool_id, material_id, machine_id, op_signature) for SF/chatter/force outputs; LRU + TTL; cache hit rate surfaced in regression dashboard.

units.title: Web UI virtualization for large lists (50-program corpus, 100+ tools, 21 machines)
units.scope: Closes PPG-REAL-MS0/U-PPR49. React-window or react-virtual on wizard tool/machine/material lists + program preview. Bench: 100ms first-paint at 1000 rows.

completion_criteria: Regression harness runs in CI on every post-touching PR; passes on main

First production cutover (one Hurco + one Okuma + the Mitsubishi MV1200R) completed and stable for 5 working days with zero rollbacks; fleet golden-corpus locked + JM Die ship playbook signed off (replaces phantom JM-PRODUCTION-CUTOVER milestone — no separate envelope required)
